measures.title: Cabarrus County School Bonds
measures.summary: Asks whether Cabarrus County may issue up to $340,000,000 in school bonds, under an order adopted July 21, 2026, to build, renovate, expand, improve and equip school buildings and other school facilities. The official ballot statement estimates the total cost over the life of the bonds at $530,780,800 ($340,000,000 principal plus $190,780,800 interest) and the property tax increase needed to repay them at $42.50 per year per $100,000 of property value. If approved, the county will levy additional property taxes sufficient to pay the principal and interest.
measures.yesMeans: Cabarrus County may issue up to $340,000,000 in school bonds and levy property taxes sufficient to repay them.
measures.noMeans: Cabarrus County may not issue these $340,000,000 in school bonds.

measures.id: Cabarrus County Community College Bonds Referendum
measures.title: Cabarrus County Community College Bonds
measures.summary: Asks whether Cabarrus County may issue up to $60,000,000 in community college bonds, under an order adopted July 21, 2026, to build, renovate, expand, improve and equip community college facilities in the county for Rowan-Cabarrus Community College. The official ballot statement estimates the total cost over the life of the bonds at $93,667,200 ($60,000,000 principal plus $33,667,200 interest) and the property tax increase needed to repay them at $7.50 per year per $100,000 of property value. If approved, the county will levy additional property taxes sufficient to pay the principal and interest.
measures.yesMeans: Cabarrus County may issue up to $60,000,000 in community college bonds and levy property taxes sufficient to repay them.
measures.noMeans: Cabarrus County may not issue these $60,000,000 in community college bonds.
